Інформація про організаційну структуру Енергетичної митниці Держмитслужби. Coverage: Енергетична митниця Держмитслужби. The publisher named on the listing is Енергетична митниця Держмитслужби. Its keywords include організаційна, структура. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2020-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
